summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.92/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.92 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 6, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 22¢ lower than a week ago, 41¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.02 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.67) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.17).
